notablePrerequisites:
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five other Shrines.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Honden of Life's Web triggers.
Holding priority, activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Honden of Life's Web's ability.
Resolve the copy of Honden of Life's Web's ability, creating at least six 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Spirit tokens, adding {4}{G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Weaver of Harmony.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
